restaurants.name: Tamamura Honten / Shiga Kogen Beer
restaurants.notes: Founding brewery of Shiga Kogen Beer, an established Japanese craft brand. Taproom with shichimi-spiced bar food, en route between Yudanaka and Shiga Kogen.

restaurants.name: Uchimura Soba
restaurants.notes: Hand-cut Shinshu soba at a small shop near Yudanaka Station. Lunch only; popular pre-Snow-Monkey stop.

restaurants.name: Enza Cafe
restaurants.address: 7148 Hirao, Yamanouchi-machi, Shimotakai-gun, Nagano 381-0401 (Ichinose Family base)
restaurants.notes: On-mountain café and bar at the Ichinose base. Burgers, pizza, craft beer; après-ski hub for the English-speaking crowd.

restaurants.name: Uoichi Sushi
restaurants.notes: Counter sushi in the heart of Shibu Onsen with Japan-Sea seafood. Reservations recommended; closes early.

restaurants.name: Yakiniku Anrakutei Shibu
restaurants.notes: Local Japanese BBQ joint serving Shinshu beef and pork. Family-friendly with set menus.

restaurants.name: Hasuike Mountain Lodge Restaurant
restaurants.notes: On-mountain canteen at the Hasuike base with Japanese curry, ramen and katsu-don. Budget lunch stop between lift transfers.
